walletHowItWorks.title: How Your Wallet Works
walletHowItWorks.eoaDetail: Your private key — secured by Privy MPC. Never stored in one place.
walletHowItWorks.scaDetail: Your on-chain wallet. Holds USDC, pays gas via Paymaster, supports batched txns.
walletHowItWorks.sectionEoaBody: Your Externally Owned Account (EOA) is a standard Ethereum wallet backed by a private key. Kura secures it through Privy's MPC (Multi-Party Computation) — the key is cryptographically split across multiple secure enclaves, so no single server ever holds the full key. It acts purely as a signer.
walletHowItWorks.sectionScaTitle: SCA — The Wallet You Spend From
walletHowItWorks.sectionScaBody: Your Smart Contract Account (SCA) is a Safe smart wallet deployed on Base. It is the address your funds actually live in. Because it's a smart contract, it supports ERC-4337 account abstraction — meaning gas fees can be sponsored (Paymaster), multiple actions can be batched into one transaction, and social recovery can be added in the future.
walletHowItWorks.sectionWhyBody: Separating the signer (EOA) from the spending wallet (SCA) gives you the best of both worlds: the flexibility of smart accounts with the simplicity of a passkey-secured key. If you ever need to migrate to a new signer, your SCA address — and all your funds — stay the same.
walletHowItWorks.sectionBackupBody: Your EOA key shards are automatically backed up via iCloud Keychain (iOS) or Google Password Manager (Android), protected by your login. You can also export the raw private key through Privy's secure recovery interface if you want full self-custody at any time.
walletHowItWorks.recoverIntro: Your funds are never locked in Kura. Follow these steps to access your Smart Account from any wallet app.
walletHowItWorks.step1After: , sign in with the same email you use in Kura, and download your EOA private key (64-character hex string). This is the signer key generated by Privy MPC.
walletHowItWorks.step2After: and choose "Import account → Private Key". Paste the key exported in Step 1. This gives you full control of the EOA signer.
walletHowItWorks.step3Before: Your actual funds live in the
walletHowItWorks.step3Mid: — the green address shown above, not the EOA. Open
walletHowItWorks.step3After: (or any Safe-compatible interface), add your SCA address on Base network, and connect the imported EOA as the owner. You now have full self-custody access.
walletHowItWorks.step4Body: Once connected in the Safe interface, you can send any token (USDC, ETH, etc.) directly to an external wallet or exchange address at any time — no Kura account required.
walletHowItWorks.warning: Never share your private key or recovery phrase. Kura will never ask for it.

trackfi.title: TrackFi
trackfi.setupBody:
TrackFi uses a Passkey (Face ID / Touch ID) to protect your financial data.

Your data uses zero access encryption. Kura cannot read it — only you, verified by your device, can unlock it.
trackfi.passkeyUnsupported: TrackFi passkeys require iOS 18+ with iCloud Keychain, or Android 9+ with Google Password Manager (PRF support).
trackfi.setupHint: Use iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager. Third-party password apps often lack PRF and will fail.
trackfi.newDeviceBody:
Your passkey is registered on another device and can't be used here.

You can reset your security layer and register a new passkey on this device. Your bank and exchange connections will be preserved.
trackfi.resetWarning: This will permanently delete your encrypted financial data cache. All data will be re-synced automatically after you set up a new passkey.
trackfi.lockedBody: Authenticate with your passkey to access your financial data.

legal.identityLead: Kura Finance LLC is a software (SaaS) company. Kura is a self-custodial wallet. Kura has no access to your private keys and cannot move, freeze, or recover funds from your wallet under any circumstances. You alone control your keys.
legal.keyResponsibility: You are solely responsible for safeguarding your private keys and recovery methods; loss of keys means permanent loss of access with no recovery option through Kura.
legal.noInsurance: Funds and digital assets are not insured by the FDIC, SIPC, or any government agency.
legal.geoRestriction: The Kura self-custodial wallet is available globally without restriction. Features requiring identity verification (KYC)—including Card, securities trading via Dinari, and fiat on/off-ramp via Bridge—are not available to residents of sanctioned jurisdictions or persons on applicable restricted-party lists, and may have additional geographic restrictions imposed by underlying partners.
legal.geoRestrictionShort: Requires identity verification · Not available in all regions
legal.integratorFee: Kura receives a developer/integrator fee from Bridge and Li.Fi on transactions routed through their infrastructure. This fee is reflected in the price or fee shown to you before you confirm — Kura does not add any additional hidden markup.
legal.portfolioFooter: Token swaps are routed by third-party services (Li.Fi) and signed from your self-custodial wallet. Kura receives a developer/integrator fee from Li.Fi on routed swaps; that fee is reflected in the price or fee shown before you confirm, with no additional hidden markup. Swapped assets are signed from your wallet — Kura does not operate an order book. Kura is not an agent of Li.Fi and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Kura is not a bank, broker, exchange, money transmitter, or investment adviser.
legal.earnVault: Deposits route through a Kura-deployed FeeWrapper smart contract before reaching the corresponding third-party Morpho vault. The wrapper collects a disclosed performance fee on yield only (default 10% of yield when configured). Exact on-chain permissions — including any ability to withdraw, freeze, or redirect principal — are defined solely by the published FeeWrapper and Morpho contracts; review those contracts before depositing. Kura displays eligible vaults meeting its objective listing criteria without ranking, curating, or recommending any specific vault. Kura is not an agent of Morpho and does not guarantee vault performance, solvency, or compliance. On-chain protocols involve smart contract risk.
legal.borrow: You initiate on-chain borrow, repay, and collateral transfers on Base through your self-custodial Kura Smart Wallet via Morpho Blue. Kura does not lend money, underwrite credit, or custody your collateral or borrowed assets. Kura is not an agent of Morpho and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Positions are subject to loan-to-value limits and may be liquidated if collateral value falls. Oracle prices and market rates are set by third parties. On-chain borrowing involves smart contract and liquidation risk. Kura is not a bank, lender, broker, exchange, or investment adviser.
legal.swapTrade: Swaps are routed by third-party services (Li.Fi) and signed from your self-custodial wallet. Kura receives a developer/integrator fee from Li.Fi on routed swaps; that fee is reflected in the price or fee shown before you confirm, with no additional hidden markup. Kura does not operate an order book and does not guarantee prices, routes, or execution. Kura is not an agent of Li.Fi and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Kura is not a broker or exchange.
legal.exchangeReadOnly: Kura only reads balances for portfolio tracking. Kura does not custody your exchange funds, and does not place orders or execute trades on your exchange account. Linked providers are independent; Kura is not their agent and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance.
legal.securitiesTrade: Securities orders are submitted through Dinari, a third-party provider (or its broker-dealer partner). For these transactions you are a customer of Dinari (or its broker-dealer partner), not of Kura. Kura does not custody securities or related cash. Requires identity verification (KYC) and is not available to residents of sanctioned jurisdictions or persons on applicable restricted-party lists; additional geographic restrictions may be imposed by Dinari. Kura is not an agent of Dinari and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Kura is not a broker-dealer or securities exchange.
legal.bridge: Cross-chain transfers are routed by Li.Fi and signed from your self-custodial wallet. Kura receives a developer/integrator fee from Li.Fi on routed transfers; that fee is reflected in the price or fee shown before you confirm, with no additional hidden markup. Kura is not an agent of Li.Fi and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Kura does not operate an exchange.
legal.cardWaitlist: Kura Card is not yet available. Joining the waitlist does not guarantee access. Card features will require identity verification (KYC) and will not be available to residents of sanctioned jurisdictions or persons on applicable restricted-party lists; additional geographic restrictions may apply. Kura Finance LLC is a SaaS company and is not a bank, money transmitter, or exchange.
legal.fiatRamp: Fiat transfers to or from your wallet are processed by Bridge and other licensed partners. Funds move through those partners — Kura is not a money transmitter. Kura receives a developer/integrator fee from Bridge on routed transfers; that fee is reflected in the price or fee shown before you confirm, with no additional hidden markup. Requires identity verification (KYC) and is not available to residents of sanctioned jurisdictions or persons on applicable restricted-party lists; additional geographic restrictions may be imposed by Bridge. Kura is not an agent of Bridge and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Funds are not insured by the FDIC, SIPC, or any government agency.
legal.walletConnect: You interact with third-party dApps at your own risk using your self-custodial wallet. Kura does not control or endorse connected applications, is not their agent, and does not custody assets for those applications.
legal.riskSummary: Kura Finance LLC is a software (SaaS) company. Kura provides a self-custodial wallet and personal finance tools. Kura has no access to your private keys and cannot move, freeze, or recover funds from your wallet under any circumstances. The Kura self-custodial wallet is available globally without restriction. Features requiring identity verification (KYC)—including Card, securities trading via Dinari, and fiat on/off-ramp via Bridge—are not available to residents of sanctioned jurisdictions or persons on applicable restricted-party lists, and may have additional geographic restrictions imposed by underlying partners. Kura is not a bank, broker, exchange, money transmitter, lender, or investment adviser. Trading, swaps, card, and fiat services are provided by independent third parties; Kura is not their agent and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. On Li.Fi and Bridge routes, Kura may receive a developer/integrator fee reflected in the price or fee shown before confirmation. Earn deposits may route through a Kura-deployed FeeWrapper that collects a disclosed performance fee on yield; see the Earn notice and published contracts for details. Funds and digital assets are not insured by the FDIC, SIPC, or any government agency. Digital assets involve risk of loss, including total loss. You are solely responsible for safeguarding your private keys and recovery methods; loss of keys means permanent loss of access with no recovery option through Kura.
legal.tokenDeposit: You initiate on-chain transfers of the selected token on Base to your self-custodial Kura wallet address. Sending the wrong asset or network may result in permanent loss. Kura is not a bank, exchange, or investment adviser.
legal.trackfi: TrackFi is read-only portfolio tracking software. Kura does not custody your funds and does not execute trades on your behalf. Connected bank, broker, and wallet APIs are used solely to read balances and holdings. Your financial data is protected with zero-access encryption — only you can unlock it with your passkey. Linked providers are independent; Kura is not their agent and does not guarantee their performance, solvency, or compliance. Kura Finance LLC is a SaaS company and is not a bank, broker, exchange, or investment adviser.

crypto.borrowAvailableCreditHint:
Available Credit is how much more you can borrow across Morpho markets, based on your posted collateral and each market's LTV limit. It includes headroom from collateral in your wallet (when it meets minimum sizes) and collateral already supplied on-chain.

This is not cash in your wallet—it is borrowing capacity before you reach liquidation limits. Oracle prices and market conditions can change this amount.

Your Gnosis Pay card runs on a Smart Contract Wallet on Base.
One tap to set it up — no seed phrase needed.

Only send USDC on Base network to this address.
Sending other tokens or using a different network may result in permanent loss.

card.routingNumberInvalidHint: Enter the 9-digit ABA routing number from your check or bank app (numbers only, no dashes). U.S. banks require this exact format for ACH and wire payouts.
card.accountNumberInvalidHint: Double-check the account number from your bank statement or app. Use numbers only and omit spaces or dashes.
card.sortCodeInvalidHint: Enter the 6-digit UK sort code (numbers only). You can usually find it in your banking app or on a bank statement.
card.clabeInvalidHint: CLABE must be exactly 18 digits. It is the standard bank identifier for SPEI transfers in Mexico.
card.ibanInvalidHint: Enter your full IBAN with no spaces. You can copy it from your bank app or statement.
card.pixKeyInvalidHint: Enter a valid Pix key (CPF, email, phone, or random key) registered with your Brazilian bank.
card.bridgeInvalidParameters: Some bank details are missing or invalid.
card.bridgeInvalidParametersHint: Review the highlighted fields, fix any typos, and try again. Routing numbers must be 9 digits; account numbers should match your bank exactly.
card.unsupportedCurrencyHint: This currency is not supported for payouts in your region yet. Try USD or another supported currency.
card.sortCodeAccountRequired: Sort code and account number are required.
card.pixKeyRequired: Pix key and tax ID (CPF/CNPJ) are required.
card.addressRequired: Please complete the account holder's address.
card.streetLine1Hint: Enter 4–35 characters. U.S. addresses must include a street number (e.g. 123 Main St).
card.streetLine1TooLong: Street address line 1 is too long (max 35 characters).
card.streetLine1TooLongHint: Shorten to 35 characters or less. Put apartment or suite numbers in line 2.
card.streetLine2TooLong: Address line 2 is too long (max 35 characters).
